findings.issue: Exception name mismatch: Task 3 (03.md) defines and exports 'ClaudeOutageError' (verified at line 32 and AC line 98: 'экспортирует transcreate_via_claude, ClaudeTranscreationError, ClaudeOutageError, ...'). However, Task 7 imports 'OutageError' — not 'ClaudeOutageError' — from claude_transcreation (line 40: 'from claude_transcreation import transcreate_via_claude, ClaudeTranscreationError, OutageError'). Task 7 line 107 also erroneously states 'Task 3 экспортирует... OutageError'. This name mismatch will cause ImportError at runtime when _fallback_publish tries to import the non-existent 'OutageError' symbol. All catch blocks in Task 7 and Task 8 using 'OutageError' will also silently never match if the implementer follows Task 3's 'ClaudeOutageError' name.
findings.fix: In Task 7: replace all occurrences of 'OutageError' with 'ClaudeOutageError' to match the actual name exported by claude_transcreation (Task 3). Update the import line to: 'from claude_transcreation import transcreate_via_claude, ClaudeTranscreationError, ClaudeOutageError'. Update line 107 to say 'ClaudeOutageError'. In Task 8: same replacement in all references. Alternatively — if 'OutageError' is the intended public name — update Task 3's spec to export 'OutageError' instead of 'ClaudeOutageError'.

findings.issue: health_check() return type contradiction between Task 3 and Task 8. Task 3 (03.md line 51) defines: 'health_check(client=None) -> bool — на ClaudeOutageError возвращает False, на success True'. Task 8 describes the same function differently in three places: (1) Description line 26: 'raises если ux-guidelines.md отсутствует/нечитаемый'; (2) What-to-do line 44: 'функция возвращает None при успехе, raises если ux-guidelines.md отсутствует/нечитаемый'; (3) Dependencies line 136: 'health_check() -> None'. The TDD test (line 69) mocks it to raise FileNotFoundError, which is consistent with Task 3's behavior (FileNotFoundError from _load_prompt propagates before any API call). However, the described return type 'None' in Task 8 contradicts Task 3's '-> bool'. An implementer of Task 3 reading Task 8's cross-reference will be confused whether to return bool or None. An implementer of Task 8 testing 'if health_check() == False: ...' will find the function returns None (from Task 8 spec) and the comparison silently passes when it should not.
findings.fix: Align Task 8's description of health_check() with Task 3's authoritative spec: the function returns bool (True on success, False on API-level outage). The startup health check in main() should check: 'ok = claude_transcreation.health_check()' then 'if not ok: ...' (for API outages) AND separately 'try: _load_prompt_check()' for missing file (FileNotFoundError propagates naturally). Or simplify Task 3's health_check to raise on any problem (including API outage) and return None on success — then Task 8's 'try/except' pattern works cleanly. Either approach is valid but the two tasks must agree. Update Task 8 Dependencies section 'health_check() -> None' vs Task 3's 'health_check() -> bool'.
